extensionAttribute.description: Returns the username of the most recent console login.
extensionAttribute.scriptContentsMac:
#!/bin/zsh
# Updated by SecurityShrimp 2026 # Last User Extension Attribute # Targets macOS 12 through 26 (Tahoe), Intel and Apple Silicon # Prefer the loginwindow-tracked value (survives reboots without console # logins); fall back to `last` if that pref is missing.
user=$(/usr/bin/defaults read /Library/Preferences/com.apple.loginwindow lastUserName 2>/dev/null)
if [[ -z "$user" ]]; then user=$(/usr/bin/last -1 -t console 2>/dev/null | /usr/bin/awk '$1 != "wtmp" { print $1; exit }') fi
echo "<result>${user:-No logins}</result>"
